basis: Lymphoma occupies small-vessel lumina; CNS damage occurs in roughly 30-60% over the course. Cutaneous involvement varies geographically and is omitted under the cap.
Focal dystonia causes involuntary eye deviation; it does not establish damage to ocular structures.
Defined by reproductive gonadal tissue differentiation, without a specified covered organ or endocrine dysfunction.
Carcinoma originates in the extrahepatic bile duct, which belongs to the hepatic axis.
Inherited retinal degeneration; visual loss occurs in 10/10 patients.
Malignant mixed germ cell tumor originates in the central nervous system.
Intellectual disability and persistent skin hyperpigmentation define the syndrome; hypotonia alone does not establish primary muscle disease.
Familial susceptibility to breast cancer; breast has no axis, and susceptibility alone does not establish organ damage.
Congenital malformation of the coronary artery openings.
Malignant tumor involving the cerebellum.
Inherited bile-formation disorder; rickets in 25/33 (~76%). Intrinsic intestinal dysfunction with diarrhea/malabsorption affects roughly 30-50%; wheezing alone is insufficient.
Widespread exfoliative skin disease, often affecting hair and nails; the umbrella does not establish one immune mechanism.
Panic disorder is psychiatric; a hereditary neurological parent does not establish structural or functional neurologic damage.
Localized cutaneous mucin deposition produces persistent papules on the hands and forearms.
Anterior pituitary carcinoma; compressive visual loss and progressive field defects are frequent (30-79%). Hearing impairment and motor deficits are occasional.
Proline-biosynthesis disorder with cutis laxa (22/22) and intellectual disability (22/23); osteopenia 10/11 and hip dislocation 15/22. Cataracts 2/22; glaucoma evidence is singleton.
Defined by autonomic paraganglial and adrenal neuroendocrine tumors. Renal carcinoma and GIST are separate tumor risks, not established common organ damage.
Obstruction of the bladder outlet impairs urinary flow; bladder and urethra belong to the renal axis.
Nonsyndromic sensorineural hearing impairment occurs in 23/23 patients.
Site-unspecified adult teratoma, predominantly gonadal; no covered organ applies across the group. CNS involvement belongs to a site-specific subtype.
Carcinoma originates in the ovary as a reproductive organ; no endocrine disorder or common covered-organ damage is specified.
Site-unspecified embryonal malignancy; no organ axis is shared across the umbrella. Pulmonary and pituitary sites apply only to individual subtypes.
Denture irritation causes inflammation of oral mucosa; infection is not established by this definition.
Hereditary spastic paraplegia; fixed talipes equinovarus is frequent (30-79%). Nystagmus alone does not establish ocular tissue damage.
Sarcomatoid urothelial carcinoma originates in the urinary bladder.
